barriers.title: Choose barriers
barriers.description: An opening button will be created for each selected barrier.

import_key.title: Import an existing key
import_key.description: Enter the phone number (digits only, including country code) and the current mobile_key. This method does not send SMS.

sms_phone.title: Request an SMS code
sms_phone.description: Enter your phone number using digits only, including country code. Submit to request one SMS. A new login may sign out the Vezdehod phone app.

sms_code.title: Confirm the SMS code
sms_code.description: Enter the SMS code for {phone}. The key is saved after access is verified. If the code was confirmed but fetching barriers failed, submit again without a code. An explicit resend is available after 60 seconds.

error.invalid_phone: Enter 10–15 digits including country code, without spaces or a plus sign.
error.invalid_auth: The phone number or key was rejected. Import the current key from the phone app.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Vezdehod. Try again later.
error.no_barriers: No barriers with permission to open are available for this account.
error.unknown_barrier: The selected barrier is no longer in the available list.
error.wrong_account: Use the same phone number. Add another account as a separate integration.
error.invalid_sms_code: Invalid code. Enter the digits from the SMS and try again.
error.cannot_send_sms: The SMS request was rejected. Check the phone number and try later.
error.sms_delivery_unknown: SMS delivery could not be confirmed. Enter the code if it arrived, or request another SMS after the pause.
error.sms_cooldown: Wait 60 seconds after the previous SMS request.

abort.already_configured: This phone number is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: The imported key has been updated.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The imported credentials have been updated.

data_description.save_snapshots: Fetch a photo 3 seconds after pressing the button and save it to Media. Photo errors do not block opening.

error.invalid_auth: Replace the expired key using Reconfigure.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Vezdehod. Try again later.
error.no_barriers: No barriers with permission to open are available.
error.unknown_barrier: The selected barrier is no longer available.

unavailable.message: This barrier is currently unavailable or opening is not permitted.

busy.message: A command is already being processed. Wait a few seconds before pressing again.

invalid_auth.message: Access has expired. Import the current key from the phone app.

cannot_connect.message: Cannot send the opening command to Vezdehod.

opening_not_confirmed.message: Vezdehod did not confirm the opening command.
